data.standardized_narrative: Opening (1 January 2014) gross claims outstanding were read from the Balance Sheet prior-year column at GBP 307.877m. The report images provided do not contain a clearly legible, explicit gross prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) in a form that can be confidently extracted; therefore prior year development (gross) is not reported here. Gross written premium for 2014 is visible as GBP 125.715m. Due to limited legibility of the scanned pages, segmental premium breakdowns and detailed reserve movement notes could not be reliably extracted.
